revisions.description: Triggers a GitHub Actions workflow that has a workflow_dispatch trigger. Works with a GitHub App installation token (Actions: write) or a personal access token. See https://docs.github.com/en/rest/actions/workflows#create-a-workflow-dispatch-event

params.label: URL
params.helpertext: Defaults to the GitHub API URL the workspace's GitHub integration shares
params.name: url

params.label: Github Access Token
params.helpertext: Defaults to the token the workspace's GitHub integration shares; or enter a personal access token
params.name: token

params.label: Owner
params.helpertext: The organization or user that owns the repository
params.name: owner

params.label: Repository
params.helpertext: The repository name, without the owner
params.name: repo

params.label: Workflow
params.helpertext: The workflow's file name (e.g. deploy.yml) or numeric ID
params.name: workflow

params.label: Ref
params.helpertext: The branch or tag to run the workflow on
params.name: ref

params.label: Inputs
params.helpertext: A JSON object of the workflow's inputs, e.g. {"environment": "staging"}
params.name: inputs

results.description: The workflow run's ID, when the server reports it (github.com does); empty otherwise
results.name: runId

results.description: The workflow run's web URL, when the server reports it; empty otherwise
results.name: runUrl
